moat_type: Data-driven ad tech platform with a large inventory of mobile games and apps
primary_risk: Dependence on third-party app developers and games
sector_survival_note: The ad tech sector has seen significant consolidation and disruption in the past 30 years, with many companies failing to adapt to changing market conditions. However, AppLovin's focus on data-driven ad tech and its large inventory of mobile games and apps may provide a competitive advantage in the long term.
thesis_summary: AppLovin's data-driven ad tech platform rides the trend of increasing mobile gaming and app usage, leveraging its large inventory of mobile games and apps to deliver targeted advertising.
thesis_breaks_if: If the company fails to maintain its competitive advantage in the ad tech sector or if the trend of increasing mobile gaming and app usage reverses.
sentiment_note: The company's valuation is considered RICH, but the long-term investor should not reject a great company on valuation alone.
ten_k_highlights: The company's revenue has been rising at a rate of 96.2% over the past 5 years.
The company's gross margin has been increasing, but is still considered insufficient.
The company's return on invested capital (ROIC) has been rising at a rate of 2479.7% over the past 5 years.
valuation_note: FCF yield 3.2%, PEG 1.2, EV/EBITDA 30, P/S 22 — priced ahead of fundamentals — accumulate slowly.
